name: Root Memory
body:
Your spiritual connection to your people’s history lends itself to recalling bits of esoteric knowledge most have forgotten.

Prerequisite: Int 13, seedling.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (nature) checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.
